create_dagmanager: create a DagManager instance to maintain state for DAG-structured data and job scheduling problems
add_edge_dagmanager: add a directed edge between two nodes in the DagManager by calling add_edge with node indices
create_jobschedulemanager: create a JobScheduleManager with resource count, time horizon, max job length, and max resource size
add_job_jobschedulemanager: add a job to the JobScheduleManager at a given node index and current schedule time
calc_min_schedule_time: calculate the minimum feasible schedule time for a job using calc_min_schedule_time on JobScheduleManager
